description: Parameters of Active Power Controller including REPCA1 and REECB1.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

bus_control.description: ACBus identification number for voltage control. `0` identifies the local bus connected to this component.

from_branch_control.description: Monitored branch FROM bus number for line drop compensation (if 0 generator power will be used).

to_branch_control.description: Monitored branch TO bus number for line drop compensation (if 0 generator power will be used).

branch_id_control.description: Branch circuit id for line drop compensation. If 0 generator power will be used.
branch_id_control.descriptor: in psy this is a string representing the branch name

Freq_Flag.description: Frequency Flag for REPCA1: `false`: disable, `true`: enable.

K_pg.description: Active power PI control proportional gain.

K_ig.description: Active power PI control integral gain.

T_p.description: Real power measurement filter time constant.

fdbd_pnts.description: Frequency error dead band thresholds `(fdbd1, fdbd2)`.

fe_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on frequency error `(fe_min, fe_max)`.

P_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on power reference `(P_min, P_max)`.

dP_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on power reference ramp rates `(dP_min, dP_max)`.

P_lim_inner.description: Upper/Lower limit on power reference for REECB `(P_min_inner, P_max_inner)`.

T_pord.description: Power filter time constant REECB time constant.

title: ActiveRenewableControllerAB
